core.name: Robin's shields
core.text:
Gives every squad member a shield of up to 8% of her initial Max HP; shields last 15s and can stack up to 60s. Shielded Agents deal 25% more DMG for 15s.
Off-Field Guard lasts 60s, and her Aftershocks build Entry Points up to 120.
Using her Entry Skill gives 1 Buff Enhance Point, which her next Off-Field Guard uses to raise its DEF bonus and cap by 25%.
She recovers 15 Energy when a squad member triggers Maim.
